note: The first of a four-part series on how scientists are grappling with AI starts with mathematics and OpenAI's October release, asking whether it is a warning for other sciences or the start of a new revolution. Oxford's James Maynard is a guest.
title: AI eats science 1: the mathpocalypse
who: The Economist, Babbage podcast (host Alok Jha; guests James Maynard and Yang-Hui He)
